findings.title: Idempotency-store failure can re-open duplicate-effect risk
Pairwise relationship privacy is controlled, not operator-unlinkable
Application-state namespace does not enforce isolation
Relationship identifier resolution privacy depends on DID-method policy
Relationship authorization digest needs portable canonicalization

disposition.summary: Net assurance-strengthening implementation delta with materially stronger retry/idempotency, publication authority, proof non-retention and concurrency controls. Residual conditions remain explicit for storage-failure duplicate effects, privileged/operator correlation, application isolation, DID-resolution privacy policy and portable canonicalization.
